steps.en: OCMS receives warrant status updates from State Courts
steps.id: OCMS menerima status update warrant dari State Courts
steps.why_en: No receiver for State Courts data exists; only unrelated CAS calls.
steps.why_id: Penerima data State Courts tidak ada; hanya panggilan CAS yang tidak terkait.

steps.en: OCMS validates and reads the status update content
steps.id: OCMS memvalidasi dan membaca isi status update
steps.why_en: No validation or reading of warrant status data exists.
steps.why_id: Validasi dan pembacaan data status warrant tidak ada.

steps.en: OCMS updates the warrant records in its database
steps.id: OCMS meng-update record warrant di database
steps.why_en: No warrant records or update logic exist.
steps.why_id: Record warrant dan logika update tidak ada.

steps.en: Failed records are kept as errors for reporting
steps.id: Record yang gagal disimpan sebagai error untuk report
steps.why_en: No error storage for warrant processing exists.
steps.why_id: Penyimpanan error pemrosesan warrant tidak ada.
